title: RAG basics
text: A retrieval-augmented generation system should retrieve relevant source passages before a language model generates an answer. Retrieved context helps ground an answer in available evidence.

title: RAG evaluation
text: A RAG evaluation should measure retrieval relevance, citation correctness, answer groundedness, and abstention behavior for unanswerable questions.

title: Human review
text: Human review is appropriate before an AI system takes high-impact actions such as submitting job applications or making consequential decisions.
